one_liner: Senior Executive deputy running Air Force modernization strategy, force design, wargaming, and operational requirements at the Pentagon, acting as the A5/7 three-star's deputy.
fit_summary: This SES role requires executive leadership of Air Force capability development, expert knowledge of weapon system programs and an SCI clearance. Daniel's resume has none of these, so skip it.
eligibility: Open to the public and SES candidates (hiring paths: ses, public), so federal status is not required.
Mandatory Technical Qualifications TQ1 and TQ2 must be clearly shown in the resume; failure on either eliminates the candidate.
Must demonstrate all five Executive Core Qualifications, plus DoD Enterprise Perspective, through executive-level accomplishments.
Sensitive Compartmented Information (SCI) clearance is required; the position also supervises Special Access Required program requirements.
Bachelor's degree desired; master's or technical/management advanced degree highly desired (not mandatory).
strategy: Skip this one; his resume shows no defense capability development or requirements work.
